Name: Magic Hair Gel Loot
Author: BerryBea
Description:
[b]What this mod does:[/b]
This mod allows the item Magic Hair Gel to drop from enemies like the other trinkets do, instead of only showing up with one potential vendor at the Desert Festival.

[b]What this mod does not do:[/b]
This does not give you access to trinkets any earlier. You still have to achieve Combat Mastery after reaching level 10 in all skills.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
This should be compatible with all other mods, as long as they don't change the characteristics of the Magic Hair Gel item.

Manifest.Name: Magic Hair Gel Loot
Manifest.Description: Magic Hair Gel drops from enemies.
